description: Puppet tools: add an empty Puppet effect to layers, choose a Puppet pin tool in the Tools panel (Position, Starch, Overlap, Advanced or Bend Pin) so pins can be placed in the Composition panel, duplicate a Puppet mesh, or list the meshes and pins with their paths for set_keyframes

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

layers.description: Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true. For add_effect, duplicate_mesh and list

mesh.description: For duplicate_mesh: the mesh number, 1 = first. Default 1

tool.description: For choose_tool: position, starch, overlap, advanced or bend
